page.content:
Current NASA program to return crews to the Moon and prepare for Mars.

How Artemis program connects

  • Topic: NASA — Artemis is NASA's current program to return crews to the Moon.
  • Vehicle: Orion — Orion is the crew capsule of the Artemis program.
  • Faction: Apollo program — Artemis is NASA's later lunar-return program after Apollo.

What is Artemis program?

Artemis uses SLS, Orion, and commercial landers to restore lunar landing capability, starting with uncrewed and crewed tests around the Moon.

Key threads lead to NASA, Orion and Apollo program.
